name: _cast_Float
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI, copied verbatim): aten::_cast_Float(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor. This overload is representative only; the original Gems pytest owns the full contract for overloads, keyword arguments, returns, errors, aliasing and mutation, and tests must never be narrowed to this single signature. Semantics: unary cast that converts the dtypes the pytest exercises (int8/uint8/int16/int32/int64/bool/float16/bfloat16/float32/float64/float8_e4m3fn/float8_e5m2, where float8, bfloat16, int64 and float64 are included only when the corresponding static capability flag is set) to float32, covering strided/transposed/sliced/offset, 0-dim and empty inputs; NaN/Inf special-value inputs and deterministic rounding rows (the first integers float32 cannot represent, float16 subnormal/normal edges and largest finite value, with int64, float64 and bfloat16 rows when supported) are compared against the native reference, so the assertions, not the case list, establish agreement. The optional `non_blocking` flag is positional-or-keyword per the registered schema (default False) and is exercised omitted, False and True in the same-device call form. The op has no `out` overload (`torch.ops.aten._cast_Float.out` reports no overload named 'out'), so only the functional form exists. For a float32 input the pytest asserts the native op is a no-op that returns the input object itself (checked by identity, including 0-dim, offset and empty inputs); this conditional aliasing is overload/input-dependent behavior described here and intentionally not encoded as `returns_alias_of`, matching the selected schema's empty alias set. The backward is the upstream gradient cast back to the source dtype with no accumulation, compared value-exactly against the native gradient. Parameter metadata is supplied: `non_blocking` is optional with schema default False and is exercised omitted, False and True. Errors (missing argument, non-tensor input, invalid non_blocking, unknown keyword, extra positional) remain asserted in pytest. Registered schema strings: aten::_cast_Float(Tensor self, bool non_blocking=False) -> Tensor
